weights.note: The default weights the build scores with and the page starts from. The page's controls move intent_share, half_life_days and the family points in config/signals.json, and site/scoring.js recomputes with the same arithmetic as engine/score.py. Tiers and caps were set on 11/9 before any board was read, and any change after seeing the data goes in docs/DECISIONS.md.

fit.note: Fit, 100 points at most, for a seller of revenue operations services. Each part is the seller's own choice and the page says so. Industry comes from the seed list, open roles from the board's count (never a headcount, decision D9), and the US footprint from where the postings are. Set on 11/9 before any board was read.
